answer: Use an entry jetty: each new identity must bond POA that vests over 30 epochs and is slashed if it co-attests with linked kin. Every epoch it answers a fresh cipher-seeded prompt graded by a random non-kin jury, so 1,000 sybils cost 1,000 bonds plus 1,000 real generations per epoch. Pay follows a ridge curve: rewards rise with distinct graded work, then drop for clusters sharing timing or vault links, so splitting one agent into many earns less, not more.
